messages:
lina_csm: Idea — creating a compact 'account thermometer' one-pager for CS <> SRE <> DevEx to use during onboarding and 90d checkins. It should capture onboarding status, renewal-risk flags, and 3 customer-facing ops tips (cache/batch/stream). Who wants in?

maria_cs: In. Must capture: onboarding_stage, primary_persona, critical_flows, avg_latency_ms, error_rate_24h, last_24h_requests, warm_pool_state, prefill_flags, and a risk level (green/yellow/red) + 1-line reason.

aj_devex: I'll draft the customer-facing tips. Keep them short, no infra acronyms. Suggest 3 bullets and a tiny code snippet for client toggles.

sam_sre: Ops additions: recommend batch_size ceilings (Dedicated: 16, Hosted: 8), periodic kv_cache_size checks, and a fallback policy route to a compatible smaller model within 50ms when under spike. Quick health commands: `infractl warmpool status --tenant $TENANT` and `redwoodctl diagnose --tenant $TENANT --checks warmpool,latency,errors`.

lina_csm: @aj_devex please keep bullets <100 chars each. Also include a 'renewal signals' micro-list.

aj_devex: Draft bullets for customers:
- Enable prefix caching to reuse recent replies and reduce latency.
- Set client batch_size to 8 for a good latency/cost balance.
- Use streaming for long outputs and abort early on matches to save tokens.
Snippet (client):
```
client.config({ batch_size: 8, streaming: true, caching: 'prefill' })
```

maria_cs: Renewal signals to warn CS: 2+ week >20% weekly usage drop, avg latency >300ms rising trend, repeated 4xx spikes, negative feedback themes. Add an 'ask' field: preferred contact and best debug window.

sam_sre: For triage before paging SRE: 1) Check metrics latency `metrics:latency.p50,p95@(24h)`; 2) Verify warm_pool_state & cache hit rate; 3) Toggle client caching to aggressive for prefills. Recovery quick-play: timeout -> single-shot fallback -> alert.

ops-bot: Linked internal draft: https://internal.redwood/cs/kit/account-thermometer-draft — comment there.

lina_csm: Love it. I'll consolidate into a one-pager v0.1 and run a 3-customer pilot next Wed 10:00am PST. Ping to join.

aj_devex: Also propose a 1-question onboarding survey: "primary prompt patterns / top 3 flows" so we can auto-suggest batching/quantization.

maria_cs: Keep public copy friendly and actionable; avoid infra jargon. Add clear 'Contact CS' CTA.

sam_sre: SGTM — will add minimal SRE run steps for cache-miss recovery and a short `infractl` checklist.

lina_csm: I'll post final v0.1 by Fri EOD and tag everyone for quick review.
